question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH top10_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM payment
    GROUP BY customer_id
    ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
monthly_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_date) as payment_month,
        SUM(p.amount) as monthly_amount
    FROM payment p
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM top10_customers)
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        payment_month,
        monthly_amount,
        LAG(monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month_amount,
        monthly_amount - LAG(monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as month_diff
    FROM monthly_totals
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    payment_month,
    ROUND(month_diff, 2) as max_month_diff
FROM with_diff
WHERE month_diff IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY month_diff DESC
LIMIT 1
